title: Origin story: Lemminkainen
description: Lemminkainen was the handsome, reckless hero of the Kalevala, who pursued love and glory without heed. Slain in the river of Tuonela and chopped to pieces, he was fished out by his mother, who sewed him together joint by joint and sang him back to life — the mother's love that conquers death.
